mapper.select: SELECT A.TASK_ID taskId, B.SEQ_NO seqNo, B.FEE_TYPE feeType, B.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, B.REGIST_ORG registOrg, B.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, B.POSITION_START_DATE positionStartDate, B.POSITION_END_DATE positionEndDate, B.FEE_AMT_TOTAL feeAmtTotal, C.layering_id layeringId, /**分层代码**/ C.busi_id finprodiId, /**金融产品代码**/ C.busi_detail_type finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ C.lev lev, /**级别序号**/ C.branch branch, /**分支序列**/ D.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO A INNER JOIN TRD_ACCOUNTMF_CONFIG B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID AND B.POSITION_START_DATE <= #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND B.POSITION_END_DATE >= #{HAPPEN_DATE} INNER JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID D ON D.BUSI_ID = C.BUSI_ID AND D.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID WHERE 1=1 and A.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND A.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND A.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
